mr_title: fix(@angular-devkit/build-angular): set base-href in service worker manifest when using i18n and app-shell
mr_description: Previously, the base href was not set when using the app-shell builder and i18n.

expected_issues.title: Default '/' base href overwrites the base href of index.html
expected_issues.description:
defaultBaseHref falls back to '/' and is now also used for the index.html generation, so when the builder's baseHref option is not set the <base href> written in the application's src/index.html is overwritten with '/'.

The '/' default is only meant for the service-worker manifest. Before this change the index generator received `getLocaleBaseHref(...) || options.baseHref`, i.e. undefined when unset, which keeps the base href authored in index.html. Applications deployed under a sub-path with a hand-written `<base href="/app/">` break after the upgrade (all assets 404). The '/' fallback must be limited to the service worker.
